title: Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/obsidian-request-scan.ts so resolveObsidianEndpointViaDiscovery selects a ca
description:
Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/obsidian-request-scan.ts so resolveObsidianEndpointViaDiscovery selects a candidate by the resolve call it will actually make, and returns a URL that includes the row's advertised resolve path.

Measured live: the only producer of obsidian:note is a libp2p row with endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8401 and resolve_endpoint /v2/impulses/resolve. On that port /health returns 200, /resolve returns 404, /v2/impulses/resolve returns 200. The helper probes ${base}/health, so it selects that candidate BECAUSE it is healthy, and its callers then append /resolve and get 404 on every obsidian read. Each call site swallows it in a catch block, so it is silent.

The change, in this one file: for each candidate build the full resolve URL from the row itself — use resolve_endpoint verbatim when it is absolute, join it onto the base when it is a relative path, and fall back to /resolve only when the field is absent or empty. Probe THAT url with a real POST resolve rather than /health, and return the first one that answers 200. Do not cache a candidate when every probe failed; returning null is correct and the callers already handle it. Export the full resolve URL rather than a bare base so callers stop appending /resolve.

The existing comment saying resolve_endpoint must never be returned because it is a relative path records the wrong lesson: the fix is to join base and path, not to discard the field.

The correct pattern already exists at repos/goal-host-vessel/src/llm-router.ts around line 95, which builds resolveUrl from v.resolve_endpoint handling both absolute and relative forms. Follow it.
